games.name: Paradox [RELEASE]
games.desc:
This game may prove to pose a learning curve in the higher ranks, and has little hand holding for new players.

If you have bought the emote gamepass, please make sure you rejoin if you were already in game just in case, and then you can just hit K to open up the menu.

Controls:
Left Click - M1
R - Critical
F - Block / Parry
Q - Dash
Shift - Run
Left Alt - Shiftlock
B - Grip
G - Carry
V - Activate Special
M - Open Menu
N - Meditate
Comma - Show NPCS in range
Right Click - Feint Flashstep/Dash/M1

games.name: SCP: Facility Breach
games.desc:
SCP: Facility Breach is a casual round-based horror game that features many roles and factions to play as, with many possessing unique abilities! Massacre everyone as an anomalous entity, raid the facility as an invading insurgency, protect the Foundation as a Task Force soldier, lay waste to the EVERYTHING as Valravn, or simply evade and escape. It's up to you.

CONTROLS
Drop Item - (Keyboard: Q) (Controller: Down)
Sprint - (Keyboard: Left Shift) (Controller: Left Trigger)
Interact - (Keyboard: E) (Controller: X)

games.name: Nightlight [HORROR]
games.desc:
Welcome to Nightlight [HORROR]!

【 About 】
Lost in a forest in the dead of night, you seek out refuge in a friendly stranger's home, but something feels off. You must atone for your past greed. Collect 8 notes spelling out "Selfish." to break free. Stay vigilant, your candle is your lifeline.

This game can be difficult for new players, do not be upset if you don't beat it the first try.

【 Recommendations】
⚠️ At least 60% graphics recommended
🤝 Joining with other players can be used to your advantage
🔥 Protect your candle's flame by finding hidden matches
🎧 Headphones recommended

❗ Join the group and community
🛠️ Game is still in early testing. Many things could change. Please report bugs.

Tags: Horror, Night, Dark, Light, Scary, Night Light, Midnight, HORROR

games.name: ARCHEMARA [EARLY ACCESS]
games.desc:
Archemara is a combat-intensive co-op PVE dungeon crawler.

Archemara is currently in Early Access, your patience with any encountered bug or inconvenience is greatly appreciated!

MAIN CONTROLS
X - Draw & holster
F - Healing flask
Tab - Index Menu & close menus
M1 - Primary moveset
M1 + Shift - Secondary moveset
M1 + Ctrl - Tertiary moveset
M2 - Block & Parry
MMB - Target lock-on
Space - Dodge

All roadmaps, patch notes, & discussions are held in the Battle Core Games server.
